existing_features.title: Remove any post-login user-option/selection step so that immediately after a successful Internet Identity login the app renders the main dashboard (AppShell) without requiring the user to choose an option.

new_feature_requests.summary: Skip any post-login user-option selection and redirect users directly to the dashboard after login

Ensure that first-time profile setup (when the caller profile is missing) does not block entry into the dashboard; it may appear as a modal on top of the dashboard, but the user must still be taken directly to the dashboard shell after login.

projectName: Skip post-login user option and go directly to dashboard
